items.item: a static pod (one defined directly on a node, not through the API server) cannot use priorityClassName and must set its priority field directly to avoid being evicted under pressure

at.out: a narrow operational detail about static pods, below this topic's scope

items.item: the kubelet's eviction loop first tries to reclaim node-level resources (garbage-collecting dead pods, deleting unused images) before evicting any end-user pod at all
PriorityClass's integer value, not just its name, is what preemption and eviction priority both actually compare; an empty priorityClassName resolves to zero by default
